generation.scope: The graph of a clean integral opposite octic is a canonically embedded Gorenstein surface with K squared 68, irregularity zero and geometric genus 15. Its two projections differ from the canonical bundle by a nontrivial two-torsion line bundle, yielding a canonically embedded etale double cover. The abstract graph with the input polarization and this torsion mark is a complete invariant of the opposite matrix, with finitely many matrix classes on each fixed surface.
